summary: New GET /api/users/{target_id} public-profile endpoint + /user/[id] screen + participant/chat-author tap-to-profile navigation ALL VERIFIED end-to-end. Added TestPublicUserProfile pytest class (11 tests, all pass) covering: 401 missing/bad Bearer, 400 malformed target_id, 404 non-existent target, 200 self-view (no shared group required), 200 both-directions when caller & target share a group, 403 with correct Italian detail 'Puoi vedere solo profili di utenti con cui condividi un gruppo' when they don't, 403 after one party leaves the shared group, and 'auto-creates caller not target' behavior. PublicUser payload verified to include user_id/name/picture/gender/age/created_at and NOT leak profile_complete. Full backend regression: 73/73 pass (11 new + 62 pre-existing; the 9 TestExpiredGroupPurge tests remain pre-existing timing/throttle flakiness documented in iteration_7 and iteration_8 — deselected here, unchanged in this iteration). Frontend UI (mobile viewport 390x844): (a) participant cards render testID=participant-<user_id> for every participant including the owner; (b) tapping a participant card when the viewer is a participant navigates to /user/{id} and the profile screen shows testID=user-profile-screen with user-name='Bob Joiner', age chip '28 anni', gender chip 'Uomo' and the yellow banner 'Visibile perché siete membri dello stesso gruppo.'; (c) tapping the chat-author-<user_id> element also navigates to /user/{id} correctly and shows the profile screen (with 'Questo utente non ha ancora completato il profilo.' fallback when age/gender are null, and initial-letter fallback avatar when picture is null); (d) when the viewer is NOT a participant the italic hint 'Unisciti al gruppo per vedere il profilo dei partecipanti.' is visible and tapping the participant card does NOT navigate (stayed on /group/{id}). One PRE-EXISTING critical bug found via code review in /app/frontend/app/group/[id].tsx line 119: sendMessage references an undefined variable `fbUser` (leftover from the removed Firebase auth). This will throw ReferenceError on every send tap. Not exercised by the current review scope (which only requires the author-name to be tappable), but should be fixed. Deprecated packages check: none. React Native web deprecation console noise unchanged (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) — documented in iteration_8.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py::get_public_user correctly restricts access to shared-group members via participants.$all query and always allows self-view. Uses PublicUser (no profile_complete field) — good. Regex validation on target_id prevents path-injection.

server.py — the endpoint places _DEVICE_ID_RE validation on target_id BEFORE the db lookup, which is the right ordering and cheap. 404 vs 403 distinction is intentional: attacker cannot enumerate valid device ids (they get 403 whether or not the user exists, as long as they don't share a group — actually the current code returns 404 first if target doesn't exist, which slightly leaks existence to any authenticated caller). Minor privacy nit: consider returning 403 for both 'not found' and 'not shared' to avoid enumeration. Non-blocking for MVP.
group/[id].tsx line 119 still uses `fbUser` — this is a REAL bug left over from the Firebase removal. TypeScript should have flagged it; check if `noImplicitAny` / `strict` are enabled in tsconfig.

user/[id].tsx correctly handles all three states: loading (spinner), error (403/404 -> lock emoji + red 'Profilo non visibile' + backend detail), and success (avatar/name/chips/banner). Error branch uses raw backend message, which for 403 is the exact Italian sentence requested.
api.ts::getUser uses simple template literal — no encoding of id. Not exploitable in practice (device_id regex restricts allowed chars) but calling encodeURIComponent(id) would be defensive.
